subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared cross-channel inbound attachment metadata context contract, or keep Slack on placeholders/media paths plus download-file?
rationale: The useful fix changes the agent-facing channel/plugin contract and should be decided as a shared boundary rather than a Slack-only field shape.

options.title: Add shared attachment metadata
options.body: Introduce a narrow InboundAttachments-style context shape and populate Slack id, name, MIME type, size, local path, and download state while keeping legacy media fields compatible.

options.title: Add Slack-only metadata
options.body: Expose only Slack-specific fields faster, accepting cross-channel drift and likely future migration work.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Continue relying on fileId placeholders, MediaPaths/MediaTypes, docs, and download-file without adding a new agent metadata contract.

recommendation.title: Add shared attachment metadata
recommendation.body: Introduce a narrow InboundAttachments-style context shape and populate Slack id, name, MIME type, size, local path, and download state while keeping legacy media fields compatible.

likelyOwner.reason: The history search points to steipete as the strongest current owner for adjacent Slack file references and agent-visible fileId guidance.
